errors.text_span: Die Linie beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 1 Euro/MWh im April 2024
errors.evidence: Reference states the line starts at approximately 2 €/MWh in April 2024, not 1 €/MWh.

errors.text_span: eine deutliche Abwärtsbewegung auf etwa -6 Euro/MWh im Dezember 2024 aufweist, bevor sie bis Februar 2025 auf 5 Euro/MWh ansteigt
errors.evidence: Reference states the line falls to -6 in mid-January 2025 (not December 2024), and recovers only to -2 by February 2025 (not +5 €/MWh). The machine description also omits the intermediate drop to -3 in November and recovery to 0 in December.
The reference mentions a black horizontal line at 0 on the y-axis, which is not mentioned in the machine-generated description.

The reference describes a fall to -3 in November 2024, a recovery to approximately 0 in December 2024, and then a fall to -6 in mid-January 2025 before rising to -2 in February 2025. These intermediate movements are missing or incorrectly described in the machine output.
Reference states the line rises only to about -2 €/MWh by February 2025, not +5 €/MWh.
